summary: CB Financial Services, Inc. (Nasdaq: CBFV) filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing that it extended the termination date of its previously announced share repurchase program until August 31, 2027; the program was originally scheduled to terminate September 30, 2026. The authorization permits repurchases of up to $5.0 million of the bank holding company's outstanding common stock, par value $0.4167 per share. No per-share price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed. The program is an open-market authorization; no tender mechanics, fixed price, or regulatory clock were specified. Watch for actual repurchase pace, capacity remaining versus the $5.0 million cap, capital and liquidity constraints, and any shift toward M&A or special dividend alternatives.
